<a id="act-training"></a>
### ACT clarification-policy training

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/learning_to_clarify)

Reference implementation of action-based contrastive self-training for clarify-versus-answer decisions.

**Protocol / role:** Simulated multi-turn outcomes guide preference training; the documented example uses PACIFIC, and standalone AmbigSQL data were not verified.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

**Related papers:** [Learning to Clarify: Multi-turn Conversations with Action-Based Contrastive Self-Training](../papers/README.md#act-ambigsql)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/google-research/google-research/tree/master/learning_to_clarify) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00222)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="ambisql-system"></a>
### AmbiSQL

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/JustinzjDing/AmbiSQL)

Detects ambiguous phrases, presents multiple-choice clarification, and rewrites questions for a downstream SQL generator.

**Protocol / role:** Interactive frontend and backend; demonstration combines the clarification layer with XiYan-SQL.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced. Linked live demo not exercised.

**License / access:** Apache-2.0.

**Related papers:** [AmbiSQL: Interactive Ambiguity Detection and Resolution for Text-to-SQL](../papers/README.md#ambisql)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/JustinzjDing/AmbiSQL) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.15276)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="bird-interact-harness"></a>
### BIRD-Interact agent and simulator harness

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/bird-bench/BIRD-Interact)

Provides conversational and autonomous-agent runners, a user simulator, database environments, and an ADK implementation.

**Protocol / role:** c-Interact and a-Interact with controlled action budgets and executable tests; simulator behavior is part of the protocol.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced. Official ground-truth access procedure applies.

**License / access:** Code: MIT; benchmark data: CC BY-SA 4.0.

**Related papers:** [BIRD-INTERACT: Re-imagining Text-to-SQL Evaluation for Large Language Models via Lens of Dynamic Interactions](../papers/README.md#bird-interact)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/bird-bench/BIRD-Interact) · [Source 2](https://bird-interact.github.io/) · [Source 3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05318)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="clarity-pipeline"></a>
### CLARITY generation pipeline

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/duyvuleo/clarity)

Generates conversational examples targeting ambiguity and unanswerability from database questions and schema context.

**Protocol / role:** Generation pipeline and validation commands; released annotations and fresh generation are separate artifacts.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** Code: MIT. Spider/BIRD-derived data: CC BY-SA 4.0.

<a id="clear-system"></a>
### CLEAR

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/mengzhang18/CLEAR)

Provides a parser-independent disambiguation pipeline and evaluation setup for questions with multiple SQL interpretations.

**Protocol / role:** Schema-aware disambiguation with CLAMBSQL, AmbiQT, and AMBROSIA inputs; not a general answerability guarantee.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

**Related papers:** [CLEAR: A Parser-Independent Disambiguation Framework for NL2SQL](../papers/README.md#clear-clambsql)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/mengzhang18/CLEAR)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="clues-tool"></a>
### CLUES uncertainty decomposition

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/Bayer-Group/clues-clinical-nlp)

Decomposes output variation into interpretation ambiguity and instability within an interpretation.

**Protocol / role:** Offline similarity-matrix examples and live interpretation generation; routing thresholds require domain calibration.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** MIT.

**Related papers:** [Disentangling Ambiguity from Instability in Large Language Models: A Clinical Text-to-SQL Case Study](../papers/README.md#clues)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/Bayer-Group/clues-clinical-nlp) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12015)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="disambigparse-system"></a>
### Disambiguate First, Parse Later

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/saparina/disambiguate-then-parse)

Generates and fills in candidate natural-language interpretations before parsing each into SQL.

**Protocol / role:** Multiple-interpretation generation and SQL coverage on AMBROSIA and AmbiQT, rather than a live clarification dialogue.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** Code: MIT; upstream benchmark access terms remain separate.

**Related papers:** [Disambiguate First, Parse Later: Generating Interpretations for Ambiguity Resolution in Semantic Parsing](../papers/README.md#disambiguate-first)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/saparina/disambiguate-then-parse) · [Source 2](https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-acl.863/)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="test-suite-evaluator"></a>
### Distilled test-suite SQL evaluator

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/taoyds/test-suite-sql-eval)

Evaluates candidate and reference SQL across test databases to reduce accidental execution matches.

**Protocol / role:** Supports Spider, SParC, CoSQL, and other datasets; agreement with reference SQL cannot resolve an incorrect or incomplete reference intent.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced. Test-suite downloads were not executed.

**License / access:** Apache-2.0 code; check upstream database terms separately.

**Related papers:** [Semantic Evaluation for Text-to-SQL with Distilled Test Suites](../papers/README.md#test-suites)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/taoyds/test-suite-sql-eval) · [Source 2](https://aclanthology.org/2020.emnlp-main.29/)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="dte-system"></a>
### DTE: Detect-Then-Explain

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/wbbeyourself/DTE)

Detects and localizes ambiguous or unanswerable question spans and produces explanations.

**Protocol / role:** Weakly supervised detection and explanation with counterfactual examples; distinct from complete conversational intent repair.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

**Related papers:** [Know What I don’t Know: Handling Ambiguous and Unknown Questions for Text-to-SQL](../papers/README.md#dte-noisysp)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/wbbeyourself/DTE) · [Source 2](https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.352/)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="intentrl-system"></a>
### IntentRL

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/saparina/intentRL)

Training and inference code for structured interpretation-answer pairs, with recall and precision rewards for different input types.

**Protocol / role:** Single-response enumeration evaluated on ambiguous QA and SQL; released text-to-SQL model linked from the repository.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced. Model weights were not downloaded.

**License / access:** Code license not verified; linked text-to-SQL model card declares MIT; upstream datasets retain their terms.

**Related papers:** [Reasoning about Intent for Ambiguous Requests](../papers/README.md#intentrl)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/saparina/intentRL) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10453) · [Source 3](https://huggingface.co/irisaparina/IntentRL-Ambig-Text2SQL-4B)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="intentsql-system"></a>
### IntentSQL

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/Amine-LG/IntentSQL)

Experimental SQLite interface combines bounded model decisions, typed query plans, deterministic SQL compilation, and visible alternative readings.

**Protocol / role:** Read-only queries and result-distinct alternatives; repository evaluation is self-reported and no peer-reviewed paper was verified.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** MIT.

<a id="maic-tqa-system"></a>
### MAIC-TQA

**system** · [Official resource](https://github.com/jensenw1/ODUTQA-MDC)

Multi-agent framework for underspecified tabular QA, including scope validation, table retrieval, and SQL generation and validation.

**Protocol / role:** Dynamic dialogue-based clarification; primary task is open-domain tabular QA rather than conventional schema-conditioned SQL generation.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

<a id="parseval-tool"></a>
### ParSEval

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/sfu-db/ParSEval)

Generates test database instances guided by SQL logical-plan branches and symbolic constraints.

**Protocol / role:** Useful for distinguishing SQL queries through counterexamples; cannot establish the user's intended interpretation.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** Apache-2.0.

**Related papers:** [ParSEval: Plan-aware Test Database Generation for SQL Equivalence Evaluation](../papers/README.md#parseval)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/sfu-db/ParSEval) · [Source 2](https://www.vldb.org/pvldb/vol18/p4750-miao.pdf)

<a id="rts-sql-tool"></a>
### RTS-SQL

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/kckevinchen/RTS-SQL)

Uses candidate execution-result agreement and execution entropy to support SQL selection and abstention.

**Protocol / role:** Risk-control conclusions depend on calibration assumptions and the correctness labels used; execution agreement alone is not intent validity.

**Availability:** Public source and usage instructions inspected; not executed or independently reproduced.

**License / access:** License not verified; consult the resource and any upstream data terms before reuse.

**Related papers:** [Reliable Text-to-SQL with Adaptive Abstention](../papers/README.md#rts) · [Reliable End-to-End Text-to-SQL Generation](../papers/README.md#rts-plus)

**Sources:** [Source 1](https://github.com/kckevinchen/RTS-SQL) · [Source 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.10858) · [Source 3](https://openproceedings.org/2026/conf/edbt/paper-177.pdf)
**Content checked:** 2026-10-22.

<a id="spotit-tool"></a>
### SpotIt+

**tool** · [Official resource](https://github.com/ai-ar-research/SpotIt-plus)
